summary: The American Petroleum Institute wanted mining vehicles exempted from the ORV regulations and criticized the environmental statement for focusing almost entirely on recreational vehicles rather than giving adequate attention to mining and industrial uses. Their position was part of a broader group of mining industry commenters who objected to permit requirements and restrictions being applied to vehicles used in mineral exploration and extraction.
summary_quote: American Petroleum Institute - wanted mining vehicles exempted from regulations and felt that environmental statement emphasis was almost entirely on recreational vehicles.
